question_response: Dr. Smith is one of the best professors I have had. She explains concepts clearly and always makes time for questions after class.
The lectures were engaging and I loved how she connected theory to real world examples. Truly exceptional teaching.
I felt very comfortable asking questions in class. The environment was welcoming and inclusive for everyone.
Office hours were always available and Dr. Smith was patient and thorough in her explanations. Incredibly helpful.
The course material was challenging but Dr. Smith made sure no one felt left behind. Great support throughout the semester.
I appreciated how diverse the examples were in her datasets. It felt like she considered students from all backgrounds.
Best class I have taken so far. The workload was fair and the feedback on assignments was always constructive and specific.
Dr. Smith genuinely cares about her students. I never felt dismissed or ignored when I had concerns about the material.
The grading rubric could be a bit clearer on some assignments. I was not always sure what was expected.
More practice problems before the exam would have been helpful. I felt slightly underprepared for the midterm.
The pace of the second half of the semester was faster than the first. Some students struggled to keep up including myself.
Office hours conflicted with my work schedule most weeks. It would help to have an evening option for students with jobs.
I wished the course had more diverse representation in the reading list. Most examples came from a narrow set of perspectives.
